title: Utility of apparent diffusion coefficient values in preoperative MRI for sinonasal tumors: Categorization of benign tumors excluding Papillomas, Papillomas, and malignant tumors.

record.paper_title: Utility of apparent diffusion coefficient values in preoperative MRI for sinonasal tumors: Categorization of benign tumors excluding Papillomas, Papillomas, and malignant tumors.
record.source_excerpt: ROC analysis yielded optimal cutoff values: >1.57 for benign tumors excluding papillomas, 1.23-1.57 for papillomas, and < 1.23 for malignant tumors.
record.modeling_hypothesis: ADCmean values can be categorized into three distinct groups based on cutoff values derived from ROC analysis to differentiate between benign tumors (excluding papillomas), papillomas, and malignant tumors.

record.paper_title: Utility of apparent diffusion coefficient values in preoperative MRI for sinonasal tumors: Categorization of benign tumors excluding Papillomas, Papillomas, and malignant tumors.
record.source_excerpt: ADC-based classification achieved 68.9 % accuracy (51/74), lower than biopsy (95.4 %, 63/66), but correctly predicted tumor categories in all three cases where biopsy results were discordant with final pathology.
record.modeling_hypothesis: ADC-based classification provides a supplementary diagnostic tool that can resolve diagnostic discrepancies when biopsy results conflict with final pathology.
